section.45: The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship

45.name_native: The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship

hadiths.text: Nawwas b. Sam'an al-Ansari reported:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about virtue and vice. He said: Virtue is a kind disposition and vice is what rankles in your heart and that you disapprove that people should come to know of it
